sql_calls.sql:
SELECT sku, gtin, name, pack, case_units, case_kg, flow, dc_slot, price_inr, cost_inr
FROM store.products
WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%atta%' OR lower(pack) LIKE '%5 kg%'
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT date, sku, units_sold, revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT 'shelf_audit' AS record_type, audit_ts::text AS ts, sku, status AS value, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_count', count_ts::text, sku,
       'book_before=' || book_before || '; counted=' || counted || '; adjustment=' || adjustment,
       trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25'
  AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-05'
ORDER BY ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT 'daily_sales' AS table_name, MIN(date)::text AS min_date, MAX(date)::text AS max_date, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.inventory_book
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.stock_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*) FROM store.pos_lines;

SELECT f.date, f.sku, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.reorder_point, f.order_up_to,
       f.book_on_hand, f.on_order, f.ordered_units, f.method,
       d.units_sold, b.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.forecasts f
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.date = f.date AND d.sku = f.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.date = f.date AND b.sku = f.sku
WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND f.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND f.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY f.date;

SELECT
  SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold,
  SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr,
  COUNT(*) AS days_with_sales_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_sales_days,
  MIN(date) AS first_date,
  MAX(date) AS last_date
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT SUM(qty) AS pos_bags_sold, COUNT(*) AS pos_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

SELECT 'goods_receipt' AS event_type, received_ts::text AS ts, grn_id AS ref, sku_booked AS sku, units_booked AS units, receipt_method AS detail
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE sku_booked = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_order', created_ts::text, order_id, sku, units, reason
FROM store.store_orders
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_off', date::text, 'write-off', sku, units, reason
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY ts;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS date, bill_ts, bill_id, line, sku_scanned, qty, unit_price
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND ((bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-09' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-14')
    OR (bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-22' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29'))
ORDER BY bill_ts, bill_id, line;

SELECT audit_ts::date AS date, status, COUNT(*) AS audits
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY audit_ts::date, status
ORDER BY date, status;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_on_shelf_pct,
  MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
  MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';
